text:
nina_finance: FYI: rolling out a temporary p-card spend control for Q2 (2026-04-01 -> 2026-06-30). Max non-exempt spend per employee = $1,200/month. Please follow the exception flow if you need more. Short note below. :memo:

alex_sales: Does this block client dinner spend?

nina_finance: Client-facing meals are exempt if logged in the Travel workflow and tagged with the opportunity link. Use the Travel card.

procurement-bot: :robot_face: New tag `q2-spend-control-2026` active. Submit exceptions: https://redwood.internal/forms/purchase-request. Required fields: cost_center, vendor, projected_annual (for recurring).

tariq_eng: What about monthly SaaS subscriptions like monitoring under $1,200/mo?

nina_finance: Monthly subs count against the monthly cap unless annualized and approved. If you can annualize and it stays under $14,400/year and vendor is on the approved list, mark `annualize:true` on the form and it will route for `finance+procurement` review.

sam_ops: Any changes to GL mapping?

nina_finance: Yes: default GL for p-cards in Q2 is `5410_SaaS` for subscriptions, `5420_Infrastructure` for infra tools. Do NOT change GL on virtual cards; procurement will reclassify as needed.

alex_sales: Need an example exception payload for the form?

nina_finance: Paste this into the notes field when requesting an exception:

```
requester: alex_sales
vendor: Conferly Events
amount: 2200
category: client_meal
opportunity: OP-2026-78
approvers: manager, procurement
reason: closing dinner for strategic account
```

procurement-bot: :white_check_mark: Exception route created. New vendors will trigger a 72h security check.

nina_finance: TL;DR: Q2 temporary cap = $1,200/month non-exempt; travel & approved deal spend exempt; exceptions via form and will route to manager+procurement; GL defaults noted. We plan to reassess June 15. Ping me for edge cases. :calendar:
